criterion: which semantic relation holds between the two entities stated at the end of the text ("The relation between X and Y")

categories.name: LocatedIn
categories.definition: One entity is physically situated within another geographical or structural entity, or a facility serves a location.

categories.name: CreatorOf
categories.definition: One entity is the author, director, designer, or primary creator of an artistic or intellectual work.

categories.name: PartOf
categories.definition: One entity is a component, subdivision, or structural element of a larger entity.

categories.name: IsA
categories.definition: One entity is a type or instance of a broader category or classification.

categories.name: HeldPosition
categories.definition: A person occupied a specific role, office, or title.

categories.name: ParticipantIn
categories.definition: An entity took part in an event, competition, or process.

categories.name: OwnedBy
categories.definition: One entity has legal possession, control, or ownership over another entity or asset.

categories.name: DevelopedBy
categories.definition: An entity created or engineered a product, software, or system, especially in technology.

categories.name: ReleasedBy
categories.definition: An entity is responsible for the publication, distribution, or release of a creative work or product.

categories.name: SynonymEquivalent
categories.definition: Two entities refer to the same or a very similar concept or are identified as such.

categories.name: Kinship
categories.definition: Two entities are related by family ties.

categories.name: PlaysInstrument
categories.definition: A person is associated with playing a specific musical instrument.

categories.name: NationalityOrigin
categories.definition: An entity's origin or affiliation with a country, region, or ethnic group.

categories.name: ListedOn
categories.definition: An entity is formally included in a public register, list, or database.

categories.name: PrecedesSucceeds
categories.definition: One entity comes immediately before or after another in a sequence, series, or timeline.

categories.name: OperatedBy
categories.definition: An entity manages or runs a facility, service, or vehicle.

categories.name: Portrays
categories.definition: An entity (person) plays the role of another entity (character).

categories.name: SubjectOf
categories.definition: One entity is the topic, theme, or focus of another creative work or discussion.

categories.name: NominatedFor
categories.definition: An entity was proposed for an award, recognition, or selection.

categories.name: BroadcastBy
categories.definition: A program or content is aired or transmitted by a media organization.

categories.name: AssociatedWithLocation
categories.definition: An entity has a notable, but indirect or contextual, connection to a place.

categories.name: TributaryOf
categories.definition: A smaller stream or river flows into a larger one.

categories.name: OfficialSymbolOf
categories.definition: One entity represents another entity officially.

categories.name: BasedOn
categories.definition: A creative work draws inspiration or content directly from another source.

categories.name: Platform
categories.definition: A software or system is designed to run on a specific hardware or software environment.

categories.name: ManufacturedBy
categories.definition: An entity produced a physical product or component.

categories.name: SignedTo
categories.definition: An artist or group has a contractual agreement with a record label or similar entity.

categories.name: FoundedIn
categories.definition: An organization or entity was established in a specific location.

categories.name: YearOfEvent
categories.definition: A specific year is associated with an event or entity.

categories.name: WinnerOf
categories.definition: An entity achieved victory in a competition or award.

categories.name: MemberOf
categories.definition: A person or organization is an active affiliate of a group, party, or team.

categories.name: Species
categories.definition: An entity's biological classification or type.

categories.name: HostedBy
categories.definition: An event took place at a specific location or organization.

categories.name: CharacterIn
categories.definition: One entity is a fictional character within a creative work.

categories.name: RelatedWork
categories.definition: Two or more creative works are connected, often by the same creator or theme.

categories.name: AssociatedWith
categories.definition: An entity has a notable, but indirect, connection to another entity or concept, not primarily location-based.
